brief: A heavy old grimoire lying closed, 26 cm tall, 19 cm wide and 7 cm thick, bound in brown calf leather over wooden boards. Its spine is rounded, with four raised bands over the cords it was sewn on. Its covers are tooled blind with a border and a lozenge, and creased along the joint where they open. Its fore-edge corners are sheathed in brass, and a turned brass boss carved with a rosette sits at the middle of the front cover. The brass is polished where hands touch it and dark brown in its hollows. Its pages swell a little, yellowed and foxed at their edges, the gatherings showing on the fore-edge.
